$comment: Declares every provider this system may use. Status is probed live by /api/system and the Doctor; nothing is assumed AVAILABLE.

optionalCloud.rule: Never used implicitly; the UI always shows which engine answered.

fallback.rule: Visible fallback only; the app never claims to have heard speech that was not detected.
Spoken in the interface with real interruption; not burned into rendered video files.

research.rule: Every citation is a real retrieved URL; failures are reported per engine.

email.rule: Sending is HIGH risk, never silent, and disabled until credentials are configured.

vision.rule: Structured sources are always preferred over pixel guessing.
